steps.what: Direct nuclear medicine technologists regarding dosages, techniques, positions and projections

tasks.design: Retain patient-specific direction with the radiologist. Existing {DOCS} supplies controlled protocols while professional decisions and clarification remain counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Desired technique and dosage depend on individual clinical circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: No automatic dosage or positioning decision is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving patient-specific exceptions before a procedure.

reach.learn: Which acquisition constraints require physician direction

evidence.claim: Generic clinical documentation tools do not establish automatic patient-specific nuclear medicine direction.

assumptions: Direct clinical direction is in scope, without invented transcription work.
Patient context and desired parameters are assessed in counted work; no free suitable-dose flag.
Unchanged work introduces no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Local clinical scope and procedure mix
research_questions: Which exceptions most often need direct clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Clinical direction retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set and enforce radiation protection standards

steps.what: Establish and enforce radiation protection standards for patients and staff

tasks.design: Retain radiation-protection judgement and enforcement with the radiologist and relevant specialists. {DOCS} holds current guidance while actual safety conditions require professional review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards must fit clinical activities and actual exposure conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement of protection judgement is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising exceptions and making appropriate corrective decisions.

evidence.claim: Checklist automation does not establish safe automatic radiation-protection enforcement.

assumptions: This task owns substantive radiation-protection decisions; document drafting in another task must not claim those hours again.
Actual practice is observed in counted work; no free safety-compliant input.
No changed process means no new upkeep.
research_questions: Which conditions require direct specialist review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no safety judgement time is removed.

tasks.short: Formulate nuclear medicine department plans and procedures

steps.what: Define departmental plans, procedure requirements, responsibilities and expert decisions
Formulate draft plans and procedures from verified departmental decisions

loop.purpose: Express expert-supplied decisions in a controlled procedure structure
loop.input: Verified brief, source references and procedure template
loop.output: Draft procedure with traceable requirements and unresolved gaps
loop.check: Radiologist checks responsibilities, sequence, conditions, exceptions and fidelity to supplied expert decisions
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unresolved technical content is written manually by the responsible expert
loop.why_not_simpler: Department-specific narrative and exception wording vary beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Verify and accept the exact departmental plan and procedure version

tasks.design: Use a controlled {DOCS} template and bounded drafting loop for departmental procedures. The radiologist supplies substantive decisions, checks meaning and accepts the exact version for the local governance process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing agreed requirements consistently takes repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and source-bounded language drafting can assist composition without choosing clinical policy.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving clinical, safety and operational conflicts.
tasks.human_edge: The radiologist and relevant experts determine workable procedures.
tasks.altitude: More consistent expression of departmental decisions

reach.learn: Where written sequences fail in practice

evidence.claim: Controlled templates and bounded drafting can express supplied departmental decisions; the clinical and operational validity remains a human responsibility.

assumptions: Scope is general departmental planning and procedure composition; the separate radiation-protection task owns its substantive standards and enforcement.

In s1 the radiologist captures scope, owner, responsibilities, sequence, preconditions, exception actions, source versions and unresolved questions. Capture and technical decisions retain 40%; missing specialist input requires manual consultation.
Use native document templates and version controls before custom software.
Additional specialist validation is counted as 5 other-role incremental hours per 100 baseline; no free approved-procedure or safe-dose input.
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total work after expert review and procedure testing?

incremental.description: Template maintenance and extra change verification

approvals.approved_version: Exact procedure text, responsibilities, sequence, conditions, exceptions and source versions; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross=12%; minus 6 focal upkeep gives net 6%. Range 0-2% allows extensive expert rewriting and procedure testing; unmeasured E1.

steps.what: Monitor handling of radioactive materials and intervene when established procedures are not followed

tasks.design: Retain observation and intervention with the radiologist and responsible handling team. {DOCS} supplies controlled procedures without replacing verification of actual handling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe handling depends on what happens physically, including exceptions.
tasks.enabler_now: No reduction in physical oversight is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting departures promptly and responding appropriately.

reach.learn: Where practical deviations need immediate escalation

evidence.claim: Document or dashboard automation does not establish reduced observation and intervention time for radioactive-material handling.

assumptions: Actual handling oversight only; no invented log-entry baseline.
Compliance is determined through counted observation; no free compliant-handling flag.
Use existing monitoring and procedure resources.
Unchanged oversight introduces no new upkeep.
research_questions: Which handling departures require immediate intervention?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Physical safety oversight remains fully counted.
